emails.subject: October facilities newsletter
emails.body:
Welcome to the October facilities newsletter. This quarter the facilities team repainted the third floor and replaced the carpet in the east wing. Parking permits for the new garage will be issued at the front desk starting next month. The recycling program now accepts soft plastics in the blue bins near the elevators. Please remember that the gym on level two closes for cleaning every Sunday afternoon.
